about.label: About
about.heading: A bit about me.
about.text: I started in 2016 with Selenium and one belief: a good test is one nobody has to babysit. Since then I've designed testing for mobile apps, content platforms, a mainframe-to-cloud migration and a GenAI document platform. The systems got bigger and stranger; the goal stayed the same, releases nobody has to worry about. AI is the newest layer and the most interesting one, because "correct" becomes something you measure rather than assert.
